Fill internal joint pixels with the adjacent solid wood or steel shades so the silhouette visually reads as one connected object on a dark UI. Keep only a single ink line at the outside outline.

No added parts. No text, logos, shadows, lighting changes, perspective, smoothing or antialiasing. Keep true transparent background and use only the source palette. This is purely a cosmetic 2D game asset repair.
finalization: Reference establishes the solid joint treatment. The tool changed raster dimensions and colors, so runtime PNGs are finalized on the existing native integer grid by source/finish.mjs, replacing only recorded ink pixels. No CLI/API mode used.
